title: Can't read read-only text-boxes and drop-downs because text is white
body: Fixes #2074

issues.title: Can't read read-only text-boxes and drop-downs because text is white
issues.body:
In yarn-develop, when we create a new orders object, the disabled fields aren't legible.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/201523976-103e478f-9fd3-4501-9e8d-a9a18e3dc0df.png)

Steps to reproduce:
- yarn develop
- log in as `mar-`
- create new orders for `Land Resupply`
- fill in line, polygon, line
- the `new orders` form will open (based on <NewMessage>)

comments.body:
Aah, the  fix for this issue has introduced a new issue - see below:
We view these messages in JSON-Editor in two places.  In one place (view existing orders) it's on a white background.  In another place (create new orders) we're on a dark background.

Unfortunately making changes to `forms.scss` affects both json-editor instances.

So, I guess we need to try to apply the colors another way.

Steps to reproduce the below screenshot:
1. login to game P9-test
2. log in as MTG-1
3. View `My Orders`
4. Expand an orders item. See the below presentation.  
Note: in read-only view we're marking the whole form as `disabled`.  When we're creating a new message, just some fields are marked as `disabled`.  But, it looks like the same CSS styling is applied in each case.


![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/201699922-6d035231-34be-4e0e-8b43-969ec1ec00a3.png)
